pages.title: Balance Score
pages.text:
The $(bold)Balance Score$() measures how evenly spread your nutrition is across all six groups. Having five groups full and one empty scores worse than having all six groups at a moderate level.

It is shown on the left panel of the diet screen.

pages.title: Balanced vs Excess
pages.text:
$(#52c252)Balanced$() means all groups are within the healthy range of 40–80%.

$(#e05252)Excess$() means one or more groups have exceeded 80% — overeating a single group is treated as imbalance, not a bonus. Aim for even coverage, not maxing individual bars.
